Best Rune Farming Spots in Elden Ring: Level Up Fast (2026 Guide)

2026-07-27•11 min read

Elden Ring's leveling curve is punishing if you don't know where to farm. A player who grinds inefficiently can spend hours stuck on a single boss, while a player who knows the right spots can blast past content that should be far above their level. This 2026 guide breaks down the best rune farming methods for every stage of the game — from the 2,000-rune-per-run Gatefront method to the absurd 10 million+ runes per hour Mohgwyn Palace loop.

Early Game Rune Farms (Levels 1-30)

The early game is all about efficiency. You're limited in mobility, your damage is low, and you need every rune. These three spots get you from level 1 to level 30 in under 90 minutes.

Gatefront Ruins — 2,000 Runes Per Run

The soldiers and chariots around Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave are the classic early-game farm. Each soldier drops roughly 200-300 runes, and the chariot (the armored vehicle that patrols the road) is worth 2,000 runes alone. Kill it by luring it to the narrow bridge near the Gatefront Site of Grace and using heavy attacks to break its posture.

  • Runes per run: ~2,000-3,000 (soldiers + chariot)
  • Time per run: 45-60 seconds
  • Recommended level: 1-15
  • Tip: Rest at the Site of Grace to respawn everything

Stormhill Trolls — 5,000-8,000 Runes Each

The trolls roaming Stormhill are the best XP in early Limgrave. A single troll drops 5,000-8,000 runes depending on variant. Roll between their leg attacks, target the ankles, and you'll kill each in about 30 seconds. The troll just north of the Church of Elleh is the easiest — it's alone and in an open field.

  • Runes per troll: 5,000-8,000
  • Time per kill: 25-40 seconds
  • Recommended level: 10-25
  • Tip: Use a shield to block their stomp attack — it does massive posture damage

Castle Morne Early Farm — 4,000 Runes Per Run

Before fighting Edgar in Castle Morne, the outer walls are packed with weak enemies. The dogs and soldiers respawn every time you rest. Clear the outer courtyard for ~4,000 runes, rest, repeat. This is faster than Gatefront once you hit level 15.

Mid-Game Rune Farms (Levels 30-80)

Mid-game farming is where the returns get serious. You can farm 50,000+ runes per hour at this stage.

Lenne's Rise — Dragonbarrow Dragon Farming

The dragon sleeping on top of Lenne's Rise in eastern Dragonbarrow is one of the most profitable mid-game farms. Using the platform at the top of the rise, you can jump-attack the dragon's head for massive damage while it's asleep. Each kill yields approximately 50,000 runes. The dragon respawns when you rest at the Lenne's Rise Site of Grace (located in the basement of the tower).

  • Runes per dragon: ~50,000
  • Time per kill: 45-60 seconds (with jump attacks)
  • Runes per hour: ~2.5-3 million
  • Recommended level: 40-60
  • Tip: Use a +15 weapon with bleed or frost for fastest kills

Academy of Raya Lucaria — Classroom Farming

Inside the Academy, the room with the glowing puppet enemies (just before the Red Wolf of the Radagon boss) drops ~3,000 runes per clear. The puppet enemies are weak to strike damage, so use a hammer or flail. This farm is reliable and safe — no giant bosses to worry about.

  • Runes per run: ~3,000-4,000
  • Time per run: 30 seconds
  • Recommended level: 40-55

Caelid — Minor Erdtree Avatar

The Minor Erdtree Avatar in central Caelid (near the Smoldering Church) drops ~40,000 runes and can be farmed relatively quickly with a weapon that has the Bloodflame Blade Ash of War. The Avatar is weak to bleed and fire damage.

  • Runes per kill: ~40,000
  • Time per kill: 60-80 seconds
  • Runes per hour: ~1.5-2 million
  • Recommended level: 50-70

Late-Game Rune Farms (Levels 80-150)

The late game is where the big numbers happen. The best farm in the entire game lives here.

Mohgwyn Palace — The King of Rune Farming (10M+ Runes/Hour)

The Palace Approach in Mohgwyn Palace is universally acknowledged as the most efficient rune farm in Elden Ring. The method: stand at the Site of Grace at the top of the Palace Approach, walk down the stairs, and use the Swarm of Grassflies Ash of War (or any AoE bleed weapon) to kill the 10-12 Albinauric enemies lining the path. Each kill yields ~12,000 runes, for a total of ~120,000-150,000 runes per run that takes about 45 seconds.

  • Runes per run: ~120,000-150,000
  • Time per run: 45 seconds
  • Runes per hour (base): ~8-10 million
  • Runes per hour (with Gold Scarab + Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot): ~14-17 million
  • Recommended level: 80+
  • Required: Swarm of Grassflies Ash of War, or dual-wield weapons with bleed

Alternative Mohgwyn method: If you don't have Swarm of Grassflies, equip any weapon with a bleed affinity and spam heavy attacks. The Albinaurics have very low health and no aggression — they just stand there. This is the single easiest way to become overleveled in the game.

Mountaintops of the Giants — Zamor Ruins

The Ancient Hero enemies near Zamor Ruins drop ~15,000 runes each. There are 5-6 in a small area, making this a solid ~80,000-rune per run farm. The enemies hit hard, so this is only recommended for well-geared players (100+ Vigor, +24/25 weapons).

Crumbling Farum Azula — Beast Men

The beast men on the rooftops of Crumbling Farum Azula are worth ~10,000 runes each and can be picked off safely. There are 8-10 in the area surrounding the Site of Grace. Total: ~80,000-100,000 runes per run.

DLC Rune Farming Spots

The Shadow of the Erdtree DLC has its own dedicated farming spots, which are essential because the DLC areas require a much higher effective level to clear comfortably.

Realm of Shadow — Ruined Lava Pit

The enemies around the Ruined Lava Pit Site of Grace in the southern Realm of Shadow drop ~20,000 runes each. There are 6-8 enemies in the immediate vicinity. Total: ~140,000-160,000 runes per run. The enemies are aggressive, so this farm requires a combat-ready build (120+ level recommended).

Abyssal Woods — Manus Metyr Area

The ghost enemies near Manus Metyr drop ~25,000 runes each, and there are 5-6 in a small cluster. This is the highest per-enemy farm in the DLC, yielding ~125,000-150,000 runes per run in about 40 seconds.

Enir-Ilim — Outer Spiral Farm

The soldiers guarding the outer spiral of Enir-Ilim drop ~18,000 runes each, with 8 enemies in the area. This is the safest DLC farm because the enemies don't aggro until you're right on top of them. Total: ~144,000 runes per run.

Maximizing Rune Gain: The Multiplier Stack

The difference between a casual farmer and an optimized one is multiplier stacking. Elden Ring has three separate rune-boosting effects that stack multiplicatively:

  • Gold Scarab Talisman: +20% rune gain (dropped by the Misbegotten Crusader boss in Caelid)
  • Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot: +30% rune gain for 3 minutes (crafted with Rowa Fruit, Elevverb, Gold Firefly)
  • Streaky Shard (DLC): +15% rune gain for 2 minutes (found in the Realm of Shadow)

Combined total: 20% + 30% + 15% = 75% more runes from every kill. On the Mohgwyn Palace farm, this turns a 10-million-rune-per-hour session into a 17.5-million-rune-per-hour session. Always consume the Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot before starting your farm loop, and keep the Gold Scarab equipped at all times.

Recommended Levels for Major Boss Areas

If you're following this farming guide and wondering when to move on to the next area, here are the community-recommended levels for each major boss in 2026:

  • Margit, the Fell Omen: 25-30
  • Godrick the Grafted: 25-30
  • Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon: 45-55
  • Starscourge Radahn: 65-75
  • Morgott, the Omen King: 80-90
  • Fire Giant: 90-100
  • Maliketh, the Black Blade: 110-120
  • Radagon / Elden Beast (final boss): 130-150
  • Messmer the Impaler (DLC): 150 (meta level for DLC)

Final Tips for Fast Leveling

  • Don't skip mid-game farms: Lenne's Rise dragon alone gets you from level 40 to level 70 in about an hour
  • Always farm with a purpose: Know exactly what level you need before starting a session, then stop
  • Multiplayer helps: You can summon co-op players to help you kill farming targets faster — this is especially useful for Mohgwyn Palace
  • New Game+ scaling: In NG+, rune values are multiplied by roughly 1.5x-2x depending on the enemy. The Mohgwyn Palace farm in NG+7 yields over 50 million runes per hour
  • The Golden Scarab is non-negotiable: The 20% boost adds up to millions of runes over a long session

Follow this guide and you'll never be underleveled for a boss again. The key is to match your farming spot to your current progression — don't try Mohgwyn Palace at level 60, and don't waste time on Gatefront Ruins once you're past level 30. Farm smart, not hard.
